ayahs.translation_bn: তাদের অন্তর থাকে খেলায় মগ্ন। যালিমরা গোপনে পরামর্শ করে- এটা তোমাদেরই মত মানুষ ছাড়া কি অন্য কিছু? তোমরা কি দেখে-শুনে যাদুর কবলে পড়বে?

english_translations.sahih_international: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
english_translations.pickthall: With hearts preoccupied. And they confer in secret. The wrong-doers say: Is this other than a mortal like you? Will ye then succumb to magic when ye see (it)?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Their hearts toying as with trifles. The wrong-doers conceal their private counsels, (saying), "Is this (one) more than a man like yourselves? Will ye go to witchcraft with your eyes open?"
english_translations.shakir: Their hearts trifling; and those who are unjust counsel together in secret: He is nothing but a mortal like yourselves; what! will you then yield to enchantment while you see?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: and their hearts are preoccupied with trivial matters. The unjust ones whisper to each other and say, "Is he (Muhammad) more than a mere mortal like you? How can you follow that which you know is only a magic?"
english_translations.mohsin_khan: With their hearts occupied (with evil things) those who do wrong, conceal their private counsels, (saying): "Is this (Muhammad SAW) more than a human being like you? Will you submit to magic while you see it?"
english_translations.arberry: diverted their hearts. The evildoers whisper one to another, 'Is this aught but a mortal like to yourselves? What, will you take to sorcery with your eyes open?'

ayahs.translation_en: The Prophet said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."

ayahs.translation_bn: তারা এও বলে, ‘এসব অলীক স্বপ্ন, না হয় সে মিথ্যে উদ্ভাবন করেছে, না হয় সে একজন কবি। কাজেই সে আমাদের কাছে এমন নিদর্শন নিয়ে আসুক যেমন পূর্ববর্তী (নবী)-গণের কাছে পাঠানো হয়েছিল।
ayahs.translation_en: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."

english_translations.sahih_international: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."
english_translations.pickthall: Nay, say they, (these are but) muddled dreams; nay, he hath but invented it; nay, he is but a poet. Let him bring us a portent even as those of old (who were Allah's messengers) were sent (with portents).
english_translations.yusuf_ali: "Nay," they say, "(these are) medleys of dream! - Nay, He forged it! - Nay, He is (but) a poet! Let him then bring us a Sign like the ones that were sent to (Prophets) of old!"
english_translations.shakir: Nay! say they: Medleys of dreams; nay! he has forged it; nay! he is a poet; so let him bring to us a sign as the former (prophets) were sent (with).
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: They have said, "It, (the Quran), is only the result of some confused dreams. He is only a poet. He should show us some miracles, as the ancient Prophets had done."
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Nay, they say:"These (revelations of the Quran which are inspired to Muhammad SAW) are mixed up false dreams! Nay, he has invented it! Nay, he is a poet! Let him then bring us an Ayah (sign as a proof) like the ones (Prophets) that were sent before (with signs)!"
english_translations.arberry: Nay, but they say: 'A hotchpotch of nightmares! Nay, he has forged it; nay, he is a poet! Now therefore let him bring us a sign, even as the ancient ones were sent as Messengers.'

english_translations.sahih_international: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
english_translations.pickthall: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were of one piece, then We parted them, and we made every living thing of water? Will they not then believe?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Do not the Unbelievers see that the heavens and the earth were joined together (as one unit of creation), before we clove them asunder? We made from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?
english_translations.shakir: Do not those who disbelieve see that the heavens and the earth were closed up, but We have opened them; and We have made of water everything living, will they not then believe?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Have the unbelievers not ever considered that the heavens and the earth were one piece and that We tore them apart from one another. From water We have created all living things. Will they then have no faith?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were joined together as one united piece, then We parted them? And We have made from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?
english_translations.arberry: Have not the unbelievers then beheld that the heavens and the earth were a mass all sewn up, and then We unstitched them and of water fashioned every living thing? Will they not believe?

ayahs.translation_bn: আর পৃথিবীতে আমি স্থাপন করেছি সুদৃঢ় পর্বত যাতে পৃথিবী তাদেরকে নিয়ে নড়াচড়া না করে। আর তাতে সৃষ্টি করেছি প্রশস্ত পথ যাতে তারা পথ পেতে পারে।

ayahs.transliteration: wamā jaʿalnā libasharin min qablika l-khul'da afa-in mitta fahumu l-khālidūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমার পূর্বেও আমি কোন মানুষকে চিরস্থায়ী করিনি। তুমি যদি মারা যাও, তাহলে তারা কি চিরস্থায়ী হবে?
ayahs.translation_en: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?

ayahs.transliteration: kullu nafsin dhāiqatu l-mawti wanablūkum bil-shari wal-khayri fit'natan wa-ilaynā tur'jaʿūna
ayahs.translation_bn: প্রত্যেক আত্মাকে মৃত্যু আস্বাদন করত হবে। আমি তোমাদেরকে ভাল ও মন্দ (উভয়টি দিয়ে এবং উভয় অবস্থায় ফেলে এর) দ্বারা পরীক্ষা করি। আমার কাছেই তোমাদেরকে ফিরিয়ে আনা হবে।
ayahs.translation_en: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
ayahs.conventional_en: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
ayahs.conventional_bn: প্রত্যেক আত্মাকে মৃত্যু আস্বাদন করত হবে। আমি তোমাদেরকে ভাল ও মন্দ (উভয়টি দিয়ে এবং উভয় অবস্থায় ফেলে এর) দ্বারা পরীক্ষা করি। আমার কাছেই তোমাদেরকে ফিরিয়ে আনা হবে।
ayahs.meta_bn: মৃত্যুর অনিবার্য স্বাদ ও কল্যাণ-অকল্যাণের পরীক্ষা: প্রতিটি আত্মার নশ্বরতা এবং পরীক্ষা শেষে স্রষ্টার সমীপে প্রত্যাবর্তন

ayahs.transliteration: wa-idhā raāka alladhīna kafarū in yattakhidhūnaka illā huzuwan ahādhā alladhī yadhkuru ālihatakum wahum bidhik'ri l-raḥmāni hum kāfirūna
ayahs.translation_bn: কাফিররা যখন তোমাকে দেখে, তখন তারা তোমাকে একমাত্র উপহাসের পাত্র হিসেবেই গণ্য করে। (আর তারা বলে) ‘এই কি সেই লোক যে তোমাদের দেবতাগুলোর ব্যাপারে কথা বলে? অথচ এই লোকগুলোই ‘রহমান’ (শব্দটির) উল্লেখকে অগ্রাহ্য করে।

english_translations.sahih_international: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
english_translations.pickthall: Messengers before thee, indeed, were mocked, but that whereat they mocked surrounded those who scoffed at them.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Mocked were (many) messenger before thee; But their scoffers were hemmed in by the thing that they mocked.
english_translations.shakir: And certainly apostles before you were scoffed at, then there befell those of them who scoffed that at which they had scoffed.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: They mocked the Messengers who were sent before you; thus, the torment which they had ridiculed encompassed them all.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Indeed (many) Messengers were mocked before you (O Muhammad SAW), but the scoffers were surrounded by that, whereat they used to mock.
english_translations.arberry: Messengers indeed were mocked at before thee, but those that scoffed at them were encompassed by that they mocked at.

ayahs.transliteration: qul man yakla-ukum bi-al-layli wal-nahāri mina l-raḥmāni bal hum ʿan dhik'ri rabbihim muʿ'riḍūna
ayahs.translation_bn: বল, ‘কে তোমাদেরকে রাতে আর দিনে রহমান (এর গযব) থেকে নিরাপদ রাখতে পারে? তবুও তারা তাদের প্রতিপালকের স্মরণ থেকে মুখ ফিরিয়ে নেয়।
ayahs.translation_en: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
ayahs.conventional_en: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
ayahs.conventional_bn: বল, ‘কে তোমাদেরকে রাতে আর দিনে রহমান (এর গযব) থেকে নিরাপদ রাখতে পারে? তবুও তারা তাদের প্রতিপালকের স্মরণ থেকে মুখ ফিরিয়ে নেয়।
ayahs.meta_bn: দিবারাত্র ঐশী সুরক্ষা ও অকৃতজ্ঞতা: রহমানের সার্বক্ষণিক তত্ত্বাবধান সত্ত্বেও স্মরণে চরম অনীহা
ayahs.meta_en: Continuous Biocosmic Preservation and Ungrateful Detachment
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: মান ইয়াকলা'উকুম (مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم - কে তোমাদের পাহারা দেয়, নিরাপত্তা দেয় ও রক্ষা করে)।

metadata.theme: The True Protector: The Inability of False Entities to Shield Against the Most Merciful

english_translations.sahih_international: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
english_translations.pickthall: Say: Who guardeth you in the night or in the day from the Beneficent? Nay, but they turn away from mention of their Lord!
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Say: "Who can keep you safe by night and by day from (the Wrath of) (Allah) Most Gracious?" Yet they turn away from the mention of their Lord.
english_translations.shakir: Say: Who guards you by night and by day from the Beneficent Allah? Nay, they turn aside at the mention of their Lord.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Ask them, "Who can protect them from (the wrath of) the Beneficent God during the night and day?" Yet they are neglectful about their Lord.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Say: "Who can guard and protect you in the night or in the day from the (punishment of the) Most Beneficent (Allah)?" Nay, but they turn away from the remembrance of their Lord.
english_translations.arberry: Say: 'Who shall guard you by night and in the daytime from the All-merciful?' Nay, but from the Remembrance of their Lord they are turning away.

ayahs.transliteration: am lahum ālihatun tamnaʿuhum min dūninā lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣra anfusihim walā hum minnā yuṣ'ḥabūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তবে কি তাদের এমন দেবদেবী আছে যা তাদেরকে রক্ষা করবে আমার (প্রতিরক্ষা) ছাড়াই? তারা তো নিজেদেরকেই সাহায্য করতে পারে না, আর তারা আমার বিরুদ্ধে কোন প্রতিরক্ষাও পাবে না।
ayahs.translation_en: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
ayahs.conventional_en: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তবে কি তাদের এমন দেবদেবী আছে যা তাদেরকে রক্ষা করবে আমার (প্রতিরক্ষা) ছাড়াই? তারা তো নিজেদেরকেই সাহায্য করতে পারে না, আর তারা আমার বিরুদ্ধে কোন প্রতিরক্ষাও পাবে না।
ayahs.meta_bn: মিথ্যা উপাস্যদের আত্মরক্ষার চরম অক্ষমতা: নিজেদের কোনো সাহায্য করতে না পারা এবং ঐশী আশ্রয়ের অভাব
ayahs.meta_en: Structural Vulnerability of False Deities
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: তামনা'উহুম (تَمْنَعُهُمْ - তাদের প্রতিরক্ষা দেবে/বাঁচাবে)। ইউসহাবূন (يُصْحَبُونَ - সঙ্গী বা আশ্রয় পাবে)।

metadata.theme: False Shields: The Complete Impotence of Manufactured Gods to Defend Themselves

metadata.theme_bn: মিথ্যা উপাস্যদের আত্মরক্ষার চরম অক্ষমতা: নিজেদের কোনো সাহায্য করতে না পারা এবং ঐশী আশ্রয়ের অভাব

english_translations.sahih_international: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
english_translations.pickthall: Or have they gods who can shield them from Us? They cannot help themselves nor can they be defended from Us.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Or have they gods that can guard them from Us? They have no power to aid themselves, nor can they be defended from Us.
english_translations.shakir: Or, have they gods who can defend them against Us? They shall not be able to assist themselves, nor shall they be defended from Us.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Can their gods protect them against Us? Their gods have no power even to help themselves, nor are they safe from Our retribution.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Or have they aliha (gods) who can guard them from Us? They have no power to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us (i.e. from Our Torment).
english_translations.arberry: Or have they gods that shall defend them apart from Us? Why, they are not able to help themselves, nor shall they be guarded in safety from Us.

ayahs.transliteration: bal mattaʿnā hāulāi waābāahum ḥattā ṭāla ʿalayhimu l-ʿumuru afalā yarawna annā natī l-arḍa nanquṣuhā min aṭrāfihā afahumu l-ghālibūna
ayahs.translation_bn: বরং আমিই তাদেরকে আর তাদের পিতৃ-পুরুষদেরকে পার্থিব ভোগ্যবস্তু দিয়েছিলাম আর তাদেরকে আয়ুও দেয়া হয়েছিল দীর্ঘ; তারা কি দেখছে না যে, আমি তাদের দেশকে চারপাশের (তাদের নিয়ন্ত্রিত) সীমান্ত হতে সংকুচিত করে আনছি? এরপরও কি তারা বিজয়ী হবে?’
ayahs.translation_en: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? So it is they who will overcome?
ayahs.conventional_en: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? So it is they who will overcome?
ayahs.conventional_bn: বরং আমিই তাদেরকে আর তাদের পিতৃ-পুরুষদেরকে পার্থিব ভোগ্যবস্তু দিয়েছিলাম আর তাদেরকে আয়ুও দেয়া হয়েছিল দীর্ঘ; তারা কি দেখছে না যে, আমি তাদের দেশকে চারপাশের (তাদের নিয়ন্ত্রিত) সীমান্ত হতে সংকুচিত করে আনছি? এরপরও কি তারা বিজয়ী হবে?’
ayahs.meta_bn: ভৌগোলিক সংকীর্ণতা ও অবক্ষয়: দীর্ঘ আয়ু ভোগ সত্ত্বেও সীমানার ক্রমসংকোচনে সত্যের বিজয়
ayahs.meta_en: Periphery Contraction and Geopolitical Diminution
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: নানকুসুহা মিন আতরাফিহা (نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَا - আমরা এর প্রান্তসীমা থেকে সংকুচিত/ক্ষয়সাধন করছি)। আল-গালিবূন (ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ - বিজয়ী বা বিজয়ী শক্তি)।

metadata.theme: Geopolitical Attrition: Prolonged Luxury Disrupted as the Earth Shrinks at Its Frontiers

metadata.theme_bn: ভৌগোলিক সংকীর্ণতা ও অবক্ষয়: দীর্ঘ আয়ু ভোগ সত্ত্বেও সীমানার ক্রমসংকোচনে সত্যের বিজয়

english_translations.sahih_international: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? So it is they who will overcome?
english_translations.pickthall: Nay, but We gave these and their fathers ease until life grew long for them. See they not how we aim to the land, reducing it of its outlying parts? Can they then be the victors?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Nay, We gave the good things of this life to these men and their fathers until the period grew long for them; See they not that We gradually reduce the land (in their control) from its outlying borders? Is it then they who will win?
english_translations.shakir: Nay, We gave provision to these and their fathers until life was prolonged to them. Do they not then see that We are visiting the land, curtailing it of its sides? Shall they then prevail?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We have been providing these men and their fathers with the means of enjoyment for a long time. Have they not ever considered that We populated the earth and then caused many of the inhabitants to pass away? Can they have any success (in their wickedness)?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Nay, We gave the luxuries of this life to these men and their fathers until the period grew long for them. See they not that We gradually reduce the land (in their control) from its outlying borders? Is it then they who will overcome.
english_translations.arberry: Nay, but Ourselves gave these and their fathers enjoyment of days, until their life had lasted long while upon them. What, do they not see how We come to the land, diminishing it in its extremities? Or are they the victors?

ayahs.transliteration: qul innamā undhirukum bil-waḥyi walā yasmaʿu l-ṣumu l-duʿāa idhā mā yundharūna
ayahs.translation_bn: বল, আমি তোমাদেরকে একমাত্র (আল্লাহর) ওয়াহী দ্বারাই সতর্ক করি, কিন্তু বধিররা ডাক শুনবে না যখন তাদেরকে সতর্ক করা হয়।
ayahs.translation_en: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
ayahs.conventional_en: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
ayahs.conventional_bn: বল, আমি তোমাদেরকে একমাত্র (আল্লাহর) ওয়াহী দ্বারাই সতর্ক করি, কিন্তু বধিররা ডাক শুনবে না যখন তাদেরকে সতর্ক করা হয়।

english_translations.sahih_international: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
english_translations.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I warn you only by the Inspiration. But the deaf hear not the call when they are warned.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Say, "I do but warn you according to revelation": But the deaf will not hear the call, (even) when they are warned!
english_translations.shakir: Say: I warn you only by revelation; and the deaf do not hear the call whenever they are warned.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), tell them, "I am warning you by revelation alone." The deaf do not hear any call when they are warned.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW): "I warn you only by the revelation (from Allah and not by the opinion of the religious scholars and others). But the deaf (who follow the religious scholars and others blindly) will not hear the call, (even) when they are warned [(i.e. one should follow only the Quran and the Sunnah (legal ways, orders, acts of worship, statements of Prophet Muhammad SAW, as the Companions of the Prophet SAW did)].
english_translations.arberry: Say: 'I warn you only by the Revelation'; but they that are deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.

ayahs.transliteration: wala-in massathum nafḥatun min ʿadhābi rabbika layaqūlunna yāwaylanā innā kunnā ẓālimīna
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমার প্রতিপালকের গযবের একটা নিঃশ্বাস যদি তাদের উপর পতিত হয় তবে তারা অবশ্য অবশ্যই বলে উঠবে, ‘হায় আমাদের দুর্ভাগ্য! আমরাই তো ছিলাম অপরাধী।’
ayahs.translation_en: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."
ayahs.conventional_en: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."
ayahs.conventional_bn: তোমার প্রতিপালকের গযবের একটা নিঃশ্বাস যদি তাদের উপর পতিত হয় তবে তারা অবশ্য অবশ্যই বলে উঠবে, ‘হায় আমাদের দুর্ভাগ্য! আমরাই তো ছিলাম অপরাধী।’

english_translations.sahih_international: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."
english_translations.pickthall: And if a breath of thy Lord's punishment were to touch them, they assuredly would say: Alas for us! Lo! we were wrong-doers.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: If but a breath of the Wrath of thy Lord do touch them, they will then say, "Woe to us! we did wrong indeed!"
english_translations.shakir: And if a blast of the chastisement of your Lord were to touch them, they will certainly say: O woe to us! surely we were unjust.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: If a blast of the torment of your Lord strikes them, they will say, "Woe to us! We have been unjust people."
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And if a breath (minor calamity) of the Torment of your Lord touches them, they will surely cry: "Woe unto us! Indeed we have been Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers, etc.).

english_translations.yusuf_ali: So We listened to him: and We granted him Yahya: We cured his wife's (Barrenness) for him. These (three) were ever quick in emulation in good works; they used to call on Us with love and reverence, and humble themselves before Us.
english_translations.shakir: So We responded to him and gave him Yahya and made his wife fit for him; surely they used to hasten, one with another In deeds of goodness and to call upon Us, hoping and fearing and they were humble before Us.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We answered his prayer and granted him his son, John, by making his wife fruitful. They were people who would compete with each other in good deeds and pray to Us with love and reverence. With Us they were all humble people.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: So We answered his call, and We bestowed upon him Yahya (John), and cured his wife (to bear a child) for him. Verily, they used to hasten on to do good deeds, and they used to call on Us with hope and fear, and used to humble themselves before Us.
english_translations.arberry: So We answered him, and bestowed on him John, and We set his wife right for him; truly they vied with one another, hastening to good works, and called upon Us out of yearning and awe; and they were humble to Us.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-allatī aḥṣanat farjahā fanafakhnā fīhā min rūḥinā wajaʿalnāhā wa-ib'nahā āyatan lil'ʿālamīna

ayahs.translation_en: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity, so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.

ayahs.translation_bn: কাজেই কেউ যদি মু’মিন হয়ে সৎ কাজ করে, তবে তার প্রচেষ্টা অস্বীকার করা হবে না, আমি তা তার জন্য লিখে রাখি।

ayahs.translation_en: But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally. And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised.

ayahs.translation_bn: রসূল বলেছিল- হে আমার প্রতিপালক! তুমি ন্যায্য মীমাংসা করে দাও, আর আমাদের প্রতিপালক তো দয়ার আধার। তোমরা (তাঁর বিরুদ্ধে) যে সব কথা বলছ সে বিষয়ে তিনিই একমাত্র আশ্রয়স্থল।
ayahs.translation_en: [The Prophet] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."

english_translations.sahih_international: [The Prophet] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."
english_translations.pickthall: He saith: My Lord! Judge Thou with truth. Our Lord is the Beneficent, Whose help is to be implored against that which ye ascribe (unto Him).
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Say: "O my Lord! judge Thou in truth!" "Our Lord Most Gracious is the One Whose assistance should be sought against the blasphemies ye utter!"
english_translations.shakir: He said: O my Lord! judge Thou with truth; and our Lord is the Beneficent Allah, Whose help is sought against what you ascribe (to Him).
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: He also said, "Lord, judge (us) with Truth. Our Lord is the Beneficent One whose help I ask against the blasphemies you say about Him".
english_translations.mohsin_khan: He (Muhammad SAW) said:"My Lord! Judge You in truth! Our Lord is the Most Beneficent, Whose Help is to be sought against that which you attribute (unto Allah that He has offspring, and unto Muhammad SAW that he is a sorcerer, and unto the Quran that it is poetry, etc.)!"
english_translations.arberry: He said: 'My Lord, judge Thou with truth! And our Lord is the All-merciful; His succour is ever to be sought against that you describe.'
